properties.name: Magyaróvár
properties.method: Coarse manual trace of the coloured 2021 city-history neighbourhood map, affinely georeferenced to archived OSM landmarks and road intersections.
properties.approximationNote: The broad yellow Magyaróvár quarter of the 2021 city-history map, including western residential streets and the eastern riverside projection. It is not reduced to Belváros and does not copy the location of the OSM Magyaróvár label, which lies west of this source-defined footprint. The small schematic map and manual georeference support rough search areas only; local error may be tens to hundreds of metres.

properties.name: Vár
properties.method: Reuse of the unchanged original OSM named castle-ground polygon as a rough footprint for the Vár locality.
properties.approximationNote: The named Vár locality point lies in the mapped Mosonmagyaróvári vár grounds. This uses that recognizable source site as an approximate search footprint; the castle neighbourhood may extend beyond the site. No radius or generated perimeter is used.

properties.name: Gyöngyös-telep
properties.method: Estimated enclosing street block from archived OSM geometry of the named locality streets and adjacent through streets; polygonize this explicit street list and select the closed block containing the source name point.
properties.approximationNote: Rough local search envelope bounded by Halászi út, Várallyai György utca, Sólyom utca, Gyöngyös utca, Platán sor, Gazdász utca. These streets identify a recognizable block around the named locality; the full named estate/neighbourhood may span additional blocks. This is an explicit street-network interpretation, not an official boundary or a point-radius approximation.

properties.name: Manninger János lakótelep
properties.method: Explicitly estimated envelope of the archived named estate street network: convex hull of the source vertices of the documented/identified local estate streets; no neighbourhood-point buffer or Voronoi construction.
properties.approximationNote: The municipal townscape ordinance separately names Manninger lakótelep as a housing estate. The estimate uses the envelope of the four source road ways explicitly carrying the full estate name. It is a coarse interior estate extent, not the larger surrounding block also containing the Móra locality. Straight segments between the outer source street vertices are an estimate, not surveyed estate boundaries.

properties.name: Móra Ferenc-lakótelep
properties.method: Explicitly estimated envelope of the archived named estate street network: convex hull of the source vertices of the documented/identified local estate streets; no neighbourhood-point buffer or Voronoi construction.
properties.approximationNote: Municipal street/constituency documentation names Móra Ferenc lakótelep separately. The three internal estate-named road ways define this coarse envelope. The source neighbourhood label lies north-west of these named estate roads; it is not used to stretch the geometry into the separately named Manninger estate. Buildings outside the internal road envelope may be omitted. Straight segments between the outer source street vertices are an estimate, not surveyed estate boundaries.

properties.name: Duna lakópark
properties.method: Explicitly estimated envelope of the archived named estate street network: convex hull of the source vertices of the documented/identified local estate streets; no neighbourhood-point buffer or Voronoi construction.
properties.approximationNote: The 2021 city history identifies Duna lakópark as a separate northern extension of Majorok; the local municipal-news report explains that its streets take the names of Hungarian monarchs and historical figures. The envelope of this explicit, locally connected estate street set estimates the built estate rather than copying the entire Majorok quarter. Parcel edges and later phases are not resolved. Straight segments between the outer source street vertices are an estimate, not surveyed estate boundaries.

properties.name: Lajta lakókert
properties.method: Explicitly estimated envelope of the archived named estate street network: convex hull of the source vertices of the documented/identified local estate streets; no neighbourhood-point buffer or Voronoi construction.
properties.approximationNote: The city history describes Lajta lakókert as the new housing quarter across the Lajta bridge from Mofém; the FVS identifies its Lomb utcai park. The envelope follows the connected small residential street set visible on the source map and archived OSM street plan. The Dohy and Háncs limits may include neighbouring plots; riverbank and parcel-side boundaries remain approximate. Straight segments between the outer source street vertices are an estimate, not surveyed estate boundaries.
